neighbours.label: the first sub-word piece of a split proper name, especially author initials and surname pieces in citations (Daniel G., Ben|ca, In|ag|aki, Ang|lican)
fire: For the motif of exile, see John W. Smith and Daniel G. Reid, Studies in Exile.
According to Benca in her review, sleep loss strongly affects mood.
The authors were Inagaki H., Kurahashi T., and Nishiyama S.
He attended services at the Anglican church every Sunday.
The republic of Angola lies on the southwest coast of Africa.
Nørgaard and colleagues measured airway responses in mice.
The study by Ngozi Okafor examined rural clinics in Enugu.
As noted by Gbenga Adeyemi, the market grew quickly.
quiet: For the motif of exile, see the essays collected in Studies in Exile.
According to her own review, sleep loss strongly affects mood.
The authors were three researchers from a hospital in Osaka.
He attended services at the old stone church every Sunday.
This republic lies on the southwest coast of Africa.
Several colleagues measured airway responses in mice.
The study by the ministry examined rural clinics in the east.
As noted by local traders, the market grew quickly.

notes: Output direction suppresses ' day'; the - pole is 'by day / during the day'.
